Markets.title: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 3,622 crore; revenue up 24%
Markets.summary: Adani Ports reported a 17% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 3,622 crore for the second quarter. Revenue from operations surged 24% to Rs 11,340 crore compared to the same period in the previous financial year.

Markets.title: Jio Platforms delivers biggest listing gain among India’s 5 largest IPOs, jumps 21% on debut
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms shares surged 21.35% on their market debut from the IPO price of Rs 1,119, marking the largest listing-day gain among India's five largest IPOs. Major brokerages including Nomura, Motilal Oswal, and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings driven by expectations of tariff hikes, subscriber monetisation, and digital services growth.

Markets.title: US Market: Treasury yields face pressure despite expected Fed rate pause
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields face ongoing downward pressure due to inflation, higher government borrowing, and AI investment uncertainty. Investors are closely monitoring the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy decisions and midterm elections for future economic direction.

Markets.title: Adani Green’s debt maths: Why leverage may fall below 4x as capex cycle matures
Markets.summary: Adani Green Energy plans to invest ₹2.4 lakh crore by FY30 to expand its renewable energy capacity. As these projects become operational and generate cash flow to pay off debt, the company's leverage is expected to drop below 4x.

Markets.title: BNP Paribas Q3 profit rises 14% to beat estimates; announces €1.3 billion buyback
Markets.summary: BNP Paribas reported a 14% increase in third-quarter net income to €3.46 billion, driven by record equity trading revenue. The French lender also announced a €1.3 billion share buyback program.

Markets.title: Global Market: China's yuan holds near four-year high as markets await Fed decision
Markets.summary: China's yuan stayed near a four-year high against the US dollar as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy decision. The currency was further supported by stronger-than-expected industrial profit growth in China.

Geo-Political.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Geo-Political.summary: The leaders of Norway and Finland recently held a rare phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the war in Ukraine. Following the conversation, Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that ending the conflict will not be achieved through silence.

Geo-Political.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Officials report that a ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region has been extended after beginning as a truce for stranded residents in Oleshky. Both Russian and Ukrainian authorities stated that no breaches of the truce have been reported.

Geo-Political.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
Geo-Political.summary: French football star Kylian Mbappé apologized after referring to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a "dictator" during an interview. The remark sparked a strong backlash in China, prompting the player to express regret for his ill-judged comment.

Geo-Political.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
Geo-Political.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s return to the Brazilian presidency challenges Donald Trump's strategic goals and influence in Latin America. Although their bilateral relationship has temporarily warmed, underlying disagreements threaten to spark renewed political friction between the leaders.

Geo-Political.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
Geo-Political.summary: A Dutch zookeeper with four decades of experience at the park was mauled to death by a leopard. The attack resulted in the fatal injury of the 57-year-old female employee.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
Geo-Political.summary: Marry Mubaiwa, the ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president, was freed after the attempted murder case against her collapsed. She had spent seven years on remand following her initial arrest and charges in 2019.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: Why China is defying global inflationary tide—and what it means for the world
Data & Insights.summary: While the rest of the world battles high inflation, China's inflation remains low due to domestic challenges like a housing slump and deep structural flaws. These ongoing economic weaknesses in China threaten to create negative spillover effects for the global economy.

Data & Insights.title: US Fed decision: What Kevin Warsh’s next move could be as inflation stays above 3% and jobs weaken | 3 things to watch
Data & Insights.summary: Amid persistent inflation and weakening employment, markets expect the US Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady following September's increase. Investors will be closely watching Kevin Warsh's upcoming comments for insights into the central bank's next moves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags need for 'prudent borrowing' as states face fiscal management challenges
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged state governments to adopt prudent borrowing, improve spending quality, and strengthen cash management for fiscal sustainability. He also recommended the broader use of digital platforms for lending and direct benefit transfers.

Data & Insights.title: Why India should resist the temptation to defend the rupee at any cost, Raghuram Rajan explains
Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan argues that India should avoid spending excessive resources to artificially defend the rupee's exchange rate. Instead, policymakers should accept the currency's decline when broader economic conditions drive it downward.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial credit growth nears 20%, signals private capex revival; Shaktikanta Das urges banks to fund strategic sectors
Data & Insights.summary: Industrial credit grew by nearly 20% in July, signaling an early revival in private capital expenditure. Reserve Bank Governor Shaktikanta Das urged banks to finance strategic sectors like infrastructure, semiconductors, and defence manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: Why is there a growing demand to reduce LTCG tax? How much revenue does the Indian government earn from it?
Data & Insights.summary: Investors face a double financial burden due to the combination of the Securities Transaction Tax and capital gains levies. Market experts are therefore calling for a reduction in the Long-Term Capital Gains tax.

India.title: Centre Asks Airlines To Notify Fliers Of Delays, Cancellations Ahead Of Fog Season
India.summary: The Indian government has directed airlines to notify passengers of flight delays, cancellations, and schedule changes via SMS, email, and apps. This measure aims to help travelers check their flight status before heading to the airport during the upcoming fog season.

India.title: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke Alleges Insta Crackdown By Centre, Many Say Posts Blocked
India.summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace leader Abhijeet Dipke alleged that the central government is censoring critics by blocking their Instagram posts. Several other government critics also reported similar issues with blocked content on the platform.

India.title: Kochi Police Commissioner Removed Over Mercedes Hit-And-Run Case Lapses
India.summary: The Kochi City police commissioner was removed from his position following heavy criticism over investigative lapses in a Mercedes hit-and-run case. This disciplinary action was taken by authorities to address the mishandling of the accident investigation by local police.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab: Schools Shut In Parts Of Jharkhand, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh
India.summary: Schools, colleges, and Anganwadi centres have been closed in six southern districts of Odisha due to Cyclone Arnab. Educational institutions in parts of Jharkhand and Andhra Pradesh are also shut because of the approaching cyclone.

India.title: Noida Twin Towers Echo In Ghaziabad As Court Orders Demolition Of 2 Towers
India.summary: A court in Ghaziabad has ordered the demolition of two illegally constructed towers and fined the builder 25 lakh rupees. Homebuyers and the Gulmohar Greens Residents Welfare Association had filed the petitions leading to this ruling.

India.title: UGC NET December 2026: Registration Deadline Extended To October 31, Apply Here
India.summary: The National Testing Agency has extended the registration deadline for the UGC NET December 2026 exam to October 31. Candidates can check the official website for revised application dates, fee payment deadlines, and eligibility criteria.

General.title: Energy bill help, minimum wage rise and bank taxes - what could be in the Budget?
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey will present UK tax plans on October 28. The upcoming budget may include measures on energy bill assistance, a minimum wage increase, and bank taxes.

General.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
General.summary: Polls have closed in the Israeli election without a clear winner. It remains uncertain what political steps will follow this close vote.

General.title: Defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in US after Brazil cancels his passports, sources say
General.summary: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in the US. His arrival occurred hours after he failed to surrender his passports to Brazilian authorities.

General.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
General.summary: The King has begun a nine-day Caribbean tour visiting the Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda. During the trip, he acknowledged the suffering of the past.
